item.title: Places that look like a fairy tale: from Eltz to Alberobello
item.description: Two films, fifteen stops: Eltz Castle, Mont-Saint-Michel, the Dark Hedges, Neuschwanstein, Bomarzo, Skye, Sintra, Reine, Colmar, Ghent and Alberobello – and what lies behind the fairy-tale look.

item.title: Six watermills: life and work by the mill wheel
item.description: Slup, Walsch’s mill in Týniště, Rosenauer’s mill near Horažďovice, the Běleč mill in Krňovice, Tomek’s mill in Rožnov and the Oldřetice mill at Veselý Kopec. The story behind the video, with a map.

item.title: With the band to Germany: a bus driver’s memories from 1998
item.description: May 1998, the Turnovanka brass band and a ČSAD Semily coach. Father’s Day at the station, the shooting king, a salute cannon, a club’s centenary in Meißendorf and a concert under the trees – an archive video after 28 years.

item.title: Mountain huts of the Krkonoše: homes, work and human stories
item.description: Luční, Labská, Dvoračky and vanished mountain huts. A film about life in the mountains and the story of Hanč, Vrbata and Emerich Rath.

item.title: Volcanoes of the Bay of Naples: from Vesuvius to the islands
item.description: Vesuvius, Pompeii, Herculaneum, the Phlegraean Fields and the islands. A documentary about volcanic landscapes and life around the Bay of Naples.

item.title: Vesuvius: from the Gulf of Naples to the crater rim
item.description: Ascent to Vesuvius from September 2023, view of the bay and connections for your own visit. Video, map and official park information.

item.title: Val d'Orcia and Crete Senesi: the landscape behind a Tuscan postcard
item.description: Cypress avenue at Poggio Covili and Crete Senesi hill. Aerial video, map and story of a landscape shaped by nature and farming.

item.title: Near Borovice: stone lookout tower above Roprachtice
item.description: Lookout U Borovice from a drone, its creation and current visitor information. Video and map of the Krkonoše stop.

item.title: Turin: from the city salon to the Royal Palace
item.description: Piazza San Carlo, the arcade and the journey through the center of Turin. Video story with map, historical context and visiting tips.

item.title: Spiagge Bianche: why the coast at Rosignano is white
item.description: The white beaches near Vada have an industrial story. Video, map and explanation why the appearance of the water is not a substitute for checking the conditions for swimming.

item.title: Siena: from the narrow streets to Piazza del Campo
item.description: Stroll through Siena to the cathedral and the shell-shaped square. Video, map and story of the area to which the Palio belongs.

item.title: Saturnia and Bagni San Filippo: a landscape built by water
item.description: The thermal cascades at Saturnia and the White Whale in the forest at Bagni San Filippo. Video, map and respectful visit rules.

item.title: Positano: from the view from the sea to the alleys under the dome
item.description: Cruise through Sorrento and walk through Positano. The story behind the video about the coast, the church of Santa Maria Assunta and local traditions.

item.title: Pompeii: the city behind the story of the volcanic disaster
item.description: From theaters and baths to the forum and the memory of the victims. Video, map and reading guide to daily life in ancient Pompeii.

item.title: Pisa: four monuments and the story of the Leaning Tower
item.description: Piazza del Duomo as a whole: baptistery, cathedral, bell tower and Camposanto. July 2023 video, map and movie chapters.

item.title: St. Petersburg: between the great monuments and the ordinary street
item.description: Neva, Winter Palace, Aurora and driving through the city. Story to older video with location map, chapters and architectural context.

item.title: Naples: from the Spanish Quarter to the Toledo Metro
item.description: September 2023 Naples Walk: Plebiscito, Galleria Umberto I, Maradona and Port. Video, map and direct links to chapters.

item.title: Semily Na Kruhách: Jizera, tennis and neighborhood memory
item.description: The Semil district from a drone and the story of the tennis club founded in 1928. The video with the map connects the river, the gardens and the city's history.

item.title: Montepulciano: Renaissance, Cellars and Clock Keepers
item.description: From San Biagio to the wine cellars and to Pulcinello above the clock. Travel story to video, map and distinguish history from legend.

item.title: Kozákov: lookout tower, hut and landscape below the peak
item.description: Aerial video of Kozákov and the story of the tower opened in 1995. Map, context and practical links for visiting the lookout tower.

item.title: Ferrari in Modena and Maranello: two views of one story
item.description: Workshop, engines, sports history and Fiorano in July 2023 video. Distinction of two museums, map and direct links to chapters.

item.title: Venice: the story begins on the lagoon
item.description: From Punta Sabbioni across the lagoon to the canals, the Doge's Palace and St. Mark's Basilica. Video, map and chapters of the Venice walk.

item.title: Amalfi: from port to cathedral and the story of the compass
item.description: Amalfi Cruise and Walk with Map and Video. The cathedral, the coast and the monument to Flavio Gioii, where history meets tradition.

item.title: Croatia: stone towns, rivers and the road to Pelješac
item.description: Kotli, Hum, Grožnjan, Motovun, Rastoke, Lubenice and Ston. Video story with map and tips on how to choose your own stop.

item.title: Tuscany in all senses: from cypresses to the sea
item.description: Val d'Orcia, thermal places, Siena, Florence and the coast. Guide to video chapters and topics for self-discovery of Tuscany.

item.title: Bohemian paradise: among rocks, castles and stories
item.description: Prachovské skály, Trosky, Hruboskalsko and the fabulous Střehomský mill. Video guide with location map, chapters and tips for your own trip.

item.title: Slovenia: from Sochi to mountain valleys and Štanjel
item.description: Seven stops from the riverbeds of Soča through Podbrdo and Zelenci to Solčavsko and Štanjel. Video, map and links for your own journey.

item.title: Velké Losiny: how rags became paper
item.description: The story of the hand-made paper mill, the journey from textile fibers to the sheet and the continuation of the old craft. Video, map and information to visit.

item.title: Trôo and Rochemenier: life hidden in the rock
item.description: Two forms of French rock villages: houses on the slope above the Loire and underground courtyards of former farms. Story, video and map.

item.title: Greece: mountain villages, bridges and the road to Chios
item.description: Zagori, Nymfaio, Dimitsana, Monemvasia and Pyrgi. Five faces of Greece with video, map and tips for planning your own trip.

item.title: Hoslovický mill: how people lived and worked by the water
item.description: The path of water to the wheel, the miller's work and the home of the Harant family. The story of Hoslovické mill with video, map and tips for visiting.

item.title: Spain: seven places between rocks and history
item.description: Setenil, Las Médulas, Río Tinto, Albarracín, Frías, Bardenas Reales and Besalú. Video story, map and inspiration to stop.

item.title: Portugal: from stone villages to the Atlantic
item.description: Monsanto, Sortelha, Piódão, Marvão, Linhares, Almeida and Azenhas do Mar. Seven stops in the video and on the map for your own journey.

item.title: Italy: water in Rasiglia and stories on the way to Sardinia
item.description: Rasiglia, Bomarzo, rock towns, Roccapelago, Monte Sant'Angelo, Orvieto and Su Nuraxi. Video article with map and tips.

item.title: A photographic journey through Europe: cities, mountains and coasts
item.description: A memorable journey through Europe from the Czech Republic through the Alps and north to Italy. Story for the photo video with links to its chapters.
